diagnosis: The endpoint deletes active sessions directly from Redis using sessionId from the URL route. Although checkSessionAuth ensures the caller has an active session, the handler never verifies whether sess:${sessionId} belongs to req.user.id. Any user can invalidate sessions belonging to other accounts, disconnecting active users and disrupting operations.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/sessions/sess_prod_admin_8819024/terminate HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.enterprisecloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Content-Length: 0
